verdict.rationale: Elicit documents a programmatic API with a dedicated 'Managing your Elicit API keys' help article, and its MCP server for agents like Claude Code exposes all API functionality. So users can issue credentials an agent can use, but nothing in the evidence shows those keys can be scoped or restricted. Missing for 10: per-key permission scopes, read-only or least-privilege key options, per-agent or per-project key restriction, key expiry/rotation controls, and independent corroboration.
